content.title: Los Angeles Lakers vs Miami Heat Live Stream: How to Watch NBA
content.text: The Los Angeles Lakers are in search of their eighth straight win and a season series sweep against the Miami Heat on Thursday. In a rematch of the 2020 NBA Finals, the Miami Heat host the Los Angeles Lakers on Thursday night. The Lakers have been on fire lately, going for their eighth win in a row and their 11th of their last 12. Los Angeles is coming off back-to-back wins over the Houston Rockets and is now 1.5 games ahead of the Rockets in the Western Conference standings for third place. The Heat, meanwhile, are trying to avoid losing three in a row after winning seven straight. Miami is just 0.5 games above the Atlanta Hawks for seventh place in the Eastern Conference. The Heat are also trying to avoid getting swept in the season series after the Lakers won 130-120 in Los Angeles on Nov. 2. Luka Doncic put up a triple-double with 29 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists. Austin Reaves put up another 26 points with 11 rebounds to help the Lakers win their third straight game. The Heat will be without Andrew Wiggins again due to a toe injury, while Bam Adebayo is a game time decision with a calf injury. The Lakers beat the Rockets 100-92 on the road on Monday, and followed that up with another eight-point win on Wednesday in back-to-back games in Houston by a 124-116 final. Doncic was great once again, coming within a rebound of a triple-double with 40 points, nine rebounds and 10 assists. LeBron James added another 30 just for good measure. LA was only up four with a minute and a half left in regulation when Doncic had a pass to James for a dunk. Kevin Durant turned it over on the next possession and Doncic made the Rockets pay by drilling a three to put the game away. Miami is coming off the wrong side of a 136-106 rout at the hands of the Charlotte Hornets on Tuesday. LaMelo Ball had a game-high 30 points and 13 assists and the Hornets dominated in the fourth in an otherwise close game, outscoring the Heat 40-18. Tyler Herro led Miami with 20 points and eight rebounds, but Miami struggled without Adebayo, Wiggins and Nikola Jovic. The latter was expected to return as probable, but he missed his 12th game in a row due to a back injury. Can Miami get healthy in time to avoid an extended losing streak?
